description: This file contains test cases for verifying the behavior of revision parsing and pathspec matching in Git. It defines various tests to ensure Git's 'dwim' (do what I mean) logic correctly interprets revs and pathspecs with metacharacters and special syntax.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content and message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake clock or timestamp used for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs commands, and validates output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.
